selected_candidate.name: intraday_market_close_location_profile_synchronization_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A completed session whose intrabar closing acceptance pressure follows the broad leave-one-out market clock profile may reflect market-wide rather than idiosyncratic price discovery, and that common information state may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.source_grid: Require the immutable raw 241-row stock-day identity, select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude standalone 09:30, and preserve all 240 fixed clock positions.
selected_candidate.own_profile_formula: For d_i=log(high_i/low_i), set s_i=0 when d_i=0; otherwise set s_i=(log(close_i/low_i)-log(high_i/close_i))/d_i, exactly in [-1,1].
selected_candidate.market_profile_formula: For every date and clock position, subtract the candidate stock's complete s_i profile from the deterministic same-date sum and divide by the remaining complete-profile count. Require at least 50 other profiles at every clock.
selected_candidate.factor_formula: Return the equal-clock-weight population Pearson correlation across all 240 positions between the stock s vector and its leave-one-out market-mean s vector.
selected_candidate.zero_range_rule: A valid zero-range bar necessarily has high=low=close and contributes exact neutral state zero. It remains in the 240-position support; no bar is dropped or bridged.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require all 240 selected high, low, and close values finite and strictly positive with low<=close<=high; every own state finite in [-1,1]; at least 50 leave-one-out complete profiles at every clock; and strictly positive population variance in both the own and leave-one-out market vectors. There is no positive-range-count, adjacent-pair, activity, return, or event-history minimum.
selected_candidate.availability: Known only after the signal-session 15:00 bar; no later session, daily return, quarterly value, Candidate49 observation, or provider request enters the factor.
